sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically verified for the missing correspondence linkage between the selected SN-curve type and the blade material properties; stressLifeCurveSelection links the owner to the curve type, while stressLifeCurveSelectionCorrespondenceEvidence is evidence rather than the required relationship.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the graph does not faithfully constrain the required correspondence between the selected SN-curve type and the blade material properties. It only requires a correspondence-evidence artifact to exist, which is a presence-only approximation, and it redundantly records the selected type as both the unconstrained string stressLifeCurveType and the object stressLifeCurveSelection without linking them.
